name: next-prompts
description: Band above the prompt with 3 next-step suggestions from a free Ollama cloud model; press one to draft it

model.title: Ollama models
model.description: Comma-separated, in order of preference: a model out of quota or erroring hands over to the next. Tried on the local server (the account signed in there), then, with NEXT_PROMPTS_OLLAMA_KEY set (another account's ollama.com API key), on ollama.com. Measured 2026-10-06: gemma4:31b-cloud 0.8s, gpt-oss:20b-cloud 9.5s; glm/deepseek cloud need paid credits.

agyModel.title: Gemini fallback (agy)
agyModel.description: Last resort when every Ollama source fails: this model through the Antigravity CLI, on the Gemini Pro subscription. Measured 2026-10-13: gemini-3.8-flash-low 7.8s. Empty turns it off.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server
